key_insight: PISG improves diffusion-based combinatorial optimization by amplifying constraint-aligned prediction signals before greedy decoding.
engineering_relevance: This training-free inference method improves candidate rankings for constrained optimization without retraining the solver or relying on downstream refinement.
method: Construct a structure-degraded prediction at each denoising step.
Extrapolate the unperturbed prediction away from the degraded prediction.
Apply constrained greedy decoding to the guided scores.
evidence_signal: Without downstream refinement, PISG improved all 16 tested TSP solver-scale pairs and all four MIS-ER solvers, with MIS-ER solved-cost gains up to 4.8%.
watch_item: Inference overhead is not quantified in the abstract, and evidence for Transformer-based solvers remains preliminary.
paper_title: PISG: Constraint-Aligned Signal Amplification for Diffusion-Based Combinatorial Optimization
